title: Portrait With Subtle Natural Motion
tests: Tests restrained portrait animation with temporal identity preservation rather than facial drift or a static-image zoom.

faults.what: A strong progressive zoom changes the original chest-up portrait into a tight facial close-up, cropping the hair and sweater despite the explicit fixed-camera, same-framing request.
Facial details are not perfectly preserved: the eyelash definition, mouth contour and small skin marks differ from the source.
The supplied audio report includes transcribed speech despite the no-sound request, although the reported peak of -84.3 dB indicates an extremely quiet track.

judge.summary: The woman remains recognizable and shows a blink-like eyelid movement, but a pronounced zoom violates the requested still-camera animation.

must_haves.item: The woman remains recognizably the same person as in the attachment across the entire clip.
must_haves.why: She remains recognizably the same woman throughout the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: A natural blink and subtle breathing movement are visible.
must_haves.why: The lowered eyelids at 1.9 seconds are consistent with a blink, but the sampled frames do not establish its natural timing or subtle breathing independently of the substantial zoom.

must_haves.item: Her face does not morph, drift, develop asymmetry or change identity between frames.
must_haves.why: Identity stays recognizable, but facial details are not exact: eyelash definition, lip contour and skin marks change relative to the source.

must_haves.item: Her curly dark hair, sweater and park setting remain consistent with the source.
must_haves.why: The dark curls, gray knit sweater and green park remain consistent, though increasingly cropped.

must_haves.item: The square framing and camera stay fixed in a silent video lasting approximately 5 seconds.
must_haves.why: The output is square and approximately five seconds long, but visibly zooms in throughout; the audio report also lists extremely low-level speech rather than unequivocal silence.
